title: Rightsizing / Automation
description: What the agents did: actions by type over time, rollbacks, blocked/skipped reasons, phases, and the health of the recommendation pipeline.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus-compatible data source with the hub's VictoriaMetrics (or Prometheus).

panels.title: Events in range
panels.description: Events stored by the hub in the selected time range, by type (ro_actions_total; resets on hub restart, so always read through increase()). One increment per resource listed in an event.

targets.expr:
label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="applied"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "applied", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="skipped"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "skipped", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="blocked"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "blocked", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="fallback"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "fallback", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="rolled_back"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "rolled_back", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="released"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "released", "", "")
 or label_replace((sum(increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="failed"}[$__range]))) or vector(0), "type", "failed", "", "")

panels.title: Actions over time by type
panels.description: Events per interval, stacked by type.

panels.title: Rollbacks by reason
panels.description: Health-watch rollbacks (WO-08) per interval: OOMKills, Restarts or Throttling after a change.

panels.title: Blocked reasons
panels.description: Why guardrails stopped changes the mode would allow (LowConfidence, Cooldown, HPACoupled, …), in range.

panels.title: Skipped reasons
panels.description: Deliberate no-ops in range: mode off/audit, change too small, or recommendation stale.

panels.title: Fallbacks and failures
panels.description: In-place changes that fell back to rollout, and Kubernetes API errors, by reason, in range.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (type, reason) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type=~"fallback|failed"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Workloads with events
panels.description: Event counts per workload in the selected range. Click a workload for its drill-down.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="applied"}[$__range])) > 0
sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="rolled_back"}[$__range])) > 0
sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="blocked"}[$__range])) > 0
sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="failed"}[$__range])) > 0
sum by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (increase(ro_actions_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload", type="skipped"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Workloads by phase
panels.description: Number of workloads per RightsizingRecommendation phase over time.

targets.expr: count by (phase) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, phase) (ro_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}) == 1)

panels.title: Modes and where they come from
panels.description: Workloads per effective mode and the level that set it (global-default < cluster-default < policy < annotation, D-005).

targets.expr: count by (resource, mode, source) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, resource, mode, source) (ro_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}) == 1)

panels.title: Last recommender run
panels.description: Time since the recommender last succeeded per cluster (production: every 24 h; dev: every 5 min).

panels.title: Last agent pull
panels.description: Time since each cluster's agent last pulled recommendations successfully. 'never' = the agent has not reached the hub yet (check its token and the hub URL).

panels.title: Recommender runs in range
panels.description: Recommender runs by outcome in the selected range (hub-wide, not per cluster). 'partial' = some clusters failed.

panels.title: Agent → hub requests
panels.description: Requests from each agent to the hub by result (ok, not_modified, error).

panels.title: Agent event buffer
panels.description: Events waiting in each agent's buffer for delivery to the hub, and events dropped because the buffer was full. Both should stay at 0.

panels.title: Recommender run duration
panels.description: Average duration of recommender runs completed in each interval (hub-wide).
